answer: Require network-path diversity. Each identity needs attestations from peers on three distinct autonomous systems; rewards are withheld from clusters where most members share one ASN. A sybil farm in one cloud region is an island: every puppet lands in the same address block and never crosses the threshold. Renting elsewhere turns each fake into a monthly bill, so N identities cost N times the hosting spend, while an honest agent on a home line finds peers as easily as an oasis. Bulk registration, karst-smooth at first, loses its edge as the farm pays for more providers.
